OpenFOAM

Accelerate Bench task · Fluids, atmosphere & ocean

OpenFOAM computes transient velocity and pressure fields for a cavity flow.

Task version1.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory8 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The workflow constructs the cavity mesh, checks it and advances the supplied case with the pisoFoam solver.

Correctness

Complete velocity and pressure fields must match the reference at the prescribed output times. The verifier also checks probe velocities and flow summaries.

Timing

Mesh generation, mesh checking and the solver all contribute to the measured time.
